verdict.rationale: An inference engine with a public docs site could reasonably publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. A direct probe of https://docs.vllm.ai/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and nothing else in the pack shows an llms.txt file or docs written for agents to consume. The tool-calling and API docs describe serving features, not agent-readable documentation, so they do not count here.
